description: Put a ready variation's content in the campaign email (blocks, plus subject and preview text when the variation has its own). Draft campaigns only. If the email's current content is not already a variation, it is saved first as a new variation named "Before <label>" and returned as savedPrevious, so the previous version is never lost. Translations are re-derived from the new content.

companyId.description: Company ID. If omitted, uses the currently selected company.

name: use_campaign_variation

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `use_campaign_variation` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

savedPrevious.description: The email's previous content, saved as a variation. Null when it already was one.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

variation.description: The campaign variation record returned by Sequenzy.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
